options.why_md: Right. It scans more neighbouring cells.
nlist is fixed at build time.

prompt_md: IVF with N = 2M, nlist = 2,000, nprobe = 8 and equal cells: how many stored vectors are scanned per query?
hints: Which idea applies? IVF puts vectors into k-means cells and scans only the nprobe nearest cells.
solution_md: Each cell holds 1,000 vectors. 8 cells means **8,000** (plus 2,000 centroid comparisons).

prompt_md: pgvector IVFFlat: why build the index **after** loading the data?

options.md: k-means learns the cells from the data. An index built on an empty table has meaningless centroids
Inserts are disabled after index creation
options.why_md: Inserts still work. The cells just won't fit the data well.
It's about cell quality, which affects recall.
